name: Hans-Dieter Richter
bio:
Hans-Dieter's fascination with motorsport began in his childhood, spending weekends with his grandfather tinkering with vintage cars. This passion led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in aerodynamics. After graduating, he joined a small Formula Ford team, quickly rising through the ranks due to his keen eye for detail and problem-solving abilities. His experience there laid a solid foundation for understanding the intricacies of race car performance. 

He approaches his role as Technical Director with a pragmatic and data-driven mindset. Hans-Dieter believes in a collaborative environment where every team member's insights are valued. He prioritizes continuous improvement through meticulous analysis and innovative solutions. Known for his ability to stay calm under pressure, he's particularly adept at finding solutions to complex technical challenges during high-stakes situations, making him a valuable asset to the Kart Academy.

His particular strength lies in optimizing vehicle setup for varying track conditions and driver styles, contributing to consistent performance gains.

physical.description: A tall, slender man with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a perfectly organized workspace, with everything in its designated place.
